300 is observation cap; measurement includes controller IPC/diagnostics/finish/strictgone overhead
Legacy PASS requires original finish and gone before30; crossed FAIL cannot be overwritten
At cap incomplete completion is right-censored and existing cleanup applies
Fresh600+120+180 gate and full7200 unchanged; no guarantee all phase maxima admitted

v3_delta: Authenticated owner retained before SIGINT. Every legacy decision includes actual observed monotonic/elapsed. Single-attempt emit_legacy also handles late gone/cap exception; deadline versus verification reason explicit; write failure recorded without masking primary.
